srow

components · 0.2.2 · C2 · aj-c-srow

A ruled row of the record: the 58px time column, then the content. When it holds the entry actions, its body lays them out in a gutter at the right of the text; below 1000px of container the tools drop under the text, which takes the full width. Index pages (the motion index) use it without the time column.
